summary: Telefônica Brasil S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a proposal to merge its wholly owned subsidiary, Fibrasil Infraestrutura e Fibra Ótica S.A., into itself, effective August 1, 2026. The merger aims to optimize management of telecommunications infrastructure assets and reduce costs. The equity of Fibrasil was appraised at R$ 812,613,844.28 (book value as of Dec 31, 2025) by PriceWaterhouseCoopers Auditores Independentes Ltda. The Audit and Control Committee recommended approval; the Board of Directors is expected to call an Extraordinary General Meeting. This is a corporate simplification transaction with no third-party sale or premium. Watch for shareholder approval and effective date.
